mapper.sql: id, source_type, owner_user_id, name, city, location, experience_goal, companion, budget, activity_type, style, duration, feature, duration_minutes, valid_from, valid_to, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_item ( source_type, owner_user_id, name, city, location, experience_goal, companion, budget, activity_type, style, duration, feature, duration_minutes, valid_from, valid_to, valid_start_time, valid_end_time, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{city}, #{location}, #{experienceGoal}, #{companion}, #{budget}, #{activityType}, #{style}, #{duration}, #{feature}, #{durationMinutes}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{validStartTime}, #{validEndTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_item SET name = #{name}, city = #{city}, location = #{location}, experience_goal = #{experienceGoal}, companion = #{companion}, budget = #{budget}, activity_type = #{activityType}, style = #{style}, duration = #{duration}, feature = #{feature}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_to = #{validTo}, valid_start_time = #{validStartTime}, valid_end_time = #{validEndTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity_item WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
